ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Password Spraying Attempt Using Dsacls.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects possible password spraying attempts using Dsacls

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\dsacls\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "DSACLS\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/user\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/passwd\\:.*")))
